args: import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fozzylang-init-cli-')); init_cmd = ['cargo', 'run', '-q', '-p', 'fz', '--', 'init', str(root), '--name', 'init_cli', '--template', 'rust', '--with', 'run,memory,host', '--json']; init_proc = subprocess.run(init_cmd, cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True, check=True); init_payload = json.loads(init_proc.stdout.strip()); assert init_payload['message'] == 'initialized project', init_payload; expected = [root / 'fozzy.toml', root / 'src/main.fzy', root / 'tests/run.pass.fozzy.json', root / 'tests/memory.pass.fozzy.json', root / 'tests/host.pass.fozzy.json', root / 'tests/INIT_GUIDE.md', root / '.fozzy/runs', root / '.fozzy/corpora']; missing = [str(path) for path in expected if not path.exists()]; assert not missing, missing; manifest = (root / 'fozzy.toml').read_text(); assert 'base_dir = ".fozzy"' in manifest, manifest; assert 'name = "init_cli"' in manifest, manifest; build_cmd = ['cargo', 'run', '-q', '-p', 'fz', '--', 'build', str(root), '--json']; build_proc = subprocess.run(build_cmd, cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True, check=True); build_payload = json.loads(build_proc.stdout.strip()); binary = pathlib.Path(build_payload['output']); assert binary.exists(), binary; run_proc = subprocess.run([str(binary)], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True); assert run_proc.returncode == 0, run_proc.returncode; lib_cmd = ['cargo', 'run', '-q', '-p', 'fz', '--', 'build', str(root), '--lib', '--backend', 'llvm', '--json']; lib_proc = subprocess.run(lib_cmd, cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True); assert lib_proc.returncode != 0, lib_proc.returncode; combined = (lib_proc.stdout or '') + (lib_proc.stderr or ''); assert 'not supported for `fz build --lib`' in combined, combined; print('init-cli-surface-ok')
